subject: reasoning
question: A cube of side 80 cm is painted yellow on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 8 cm each. Find the number of smaller cube having all the three faces painted.
solution:
__
 
• A cube of side 80 cm is painted yellow on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 8 cm each.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5a9307260dde9696f8a62e875a143e4ea2b0ddce39bbbd9b2f54708a2a70b64.png] 

 
• The number of smaller cube having all the three faces painted.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/179ad5a596c967c8e7e05cbe92af3719b347b4e0e7dbe84d6f3a647c318e4c28.png] 

All corner cubes are painted on three sides there are 8 corners in cubes.

So, cubes with paint on 3 sides = 8

Hence, **"8"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

If a cube has been painted red, blue, and black on pairs of opposite faces and divide it into X parts.

1) Total number of cubes = X³

2) Cubes that have three faces painted = 8 (Because there are only 8 corners in the cube)

3) Cubes which has only two faces painted = (X - 2) × No of Edges (12)

4) Cubes that have only one face painted = (X - 2)² × 6

5) Cubes that have no face painted = (X - 2)³
